name: Electromech Infraprojects Limited
industry: Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) solutions for digital infrastructure / data centres
description: We are a Mission-Critical Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) solutions provider serving the digital infrastructure sector in India, with a specialised focus on the technical design, execution, testing and commissioning of digital infrastructure for data centres, AI data centres, Global Capability Centres and Commercial & Industrial establishments. We provide multi-disciplinary service offerings spanning high and low voltage electrical works, mechanical works, fire protection and allied civil and interior fit-out works.

top_risks: Our top 5 clients contributed 75.03%, 75.59% and 66.22% of our revenue from operations for Fiscals 2026, 2025 and 2024 respectively, and the loss of any top clients could materially affect our business.

We derived 60%, 59% and 44% of our revenue from operations from the data centre segment in Fiscals 2026, 2025 and 2024 respectively, and any adverse developments in this sector could adversely affect our business.
We depend on third party suppliers for the supply of raw materials, and any disruptions in supply or price fluctuations may have an adverse impact on our operations and performance.
